title: WF04 rerun regression: API-03 integration leak and frontend no-tests failure

root_cause.description: Allocator ownership and cleanup paths in instance transition/snapshot/task handling caused integration leaks in API-03 paths; frontend unit test command failed because Vitest exited non-zero when no tests were discovered.

resolution.summary: Added ownership cleanup fixes in instance and snapshot flows, corrected integration test cleanup in related suites, and changed frontend test command to pass when no tests exist.

actions: Keep allocator ownership explicit for transition/snapshot/task objects and free in all error and success paths.
Retain no-tests-safe frontend test command in CI to avoid false workflow failures when no frontend unit tests are defined.
